backend/main.mo: Motoko canister implementing access-controlled user profiles and per-user chat histories with message append, retrieval, and clearing.
feature_evidence.json: Metadata file describing feature requirements, associated files, components, and confidence for three frontend media‑related tasks.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Mapping of frontend file paths to short functional descriptions used for build planning.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base and theme variables defining a light/dark OKLCH color palette and global styles.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with root container and script loading the React application.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Landing page showing a static photo with fallback and an audio player with play state and error handling.
frontend/src/components/chat/MessageComp: Chat input component with auto‑resizing textarea, Enter/Shift+Enter behavior, and send button.
frontend/src/components/chat/MessageThre: Renders a scrollable chat thread with styled user and companion messages, auto-scrolling on updates.
frontend/src/components/chat/TypingIndic: Displays an avatar with animated dots to show the companion is typing.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Login/logout button integrating Internet Identity auth with query cache clearing and styled states.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: Initial profile setup form prompting the user for their name with themed styling and validation.
frontend/src/components/settings/Setting: Provides a dialog UI for editing companion name, relationship vibe, and conversation style.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor, refreshing queries when identity changes.
Manages companion settings with localStorage persistence and an update helper.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity context and provider for login, logout, and identity state.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Wraps backend calls for profiles, conversations, and message sending, integrating reply generation and cache invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and custom color variables for light and dark themes with animations.
frontend/src/lib/replyEngine/generateRep: Generates companion replies using intent detection, templates, seeded randomness, and safety filters.
frontend/src/lib/replyEngine/intents.ts: Detects message intent using regex patterns mapped to predefined intent types.
frontend/src/lib/replyEngine/persona.ts: Defines persona boundaries, style configuration, and a filter that replaces inappropriate responses with a safe fallback.
frontend/src/lib/replyEngine/responseLib: Provides predefined response templates organized by intent and relationship vibe for the reply engine.
frontend/src/lib/replyEngine/seededRando: Implements a simple seeded random generator and helper to deterministically select a variant from a list.
frontend/src/lib/siteMetadata.ts: Updates document title and meta tags for site name and Open Graph metadata.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React application with QueryClient and InternetIdentity providers.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters using query strings, hash routing, and sessionStorage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending theme colors, typography, animations, and plugins.
project_state.json: Project state metadata describing issues with missing media assets and required fixes for photo and music loading.
